title: 2025 AMC 12A Problem 16
statement: Triangle \(\triangle ABC\) has side lengths \(AB = 80,\) \(BC = 45,\) and \(AC = 75.\) The bisector of \(\angle B\) and the altitude to side \(AB\) intersect at point \(P.\) What is \(BP?\)

solutions.text:
By the Law of Cosines, \[ \begin{aligned} \cos B &= \frac{80^2 + 45^2 - 75^2}{2 \cdot 80 \cdot 45} \\ &= \frac{2800}{7200} = \frac{7}{18}. \end{aligned} \]

The altitude to \(AB\) is drawn from \(C,\) and its foot is at distance \(BC\cos B = 45 \cdot \dfrac{7}{18} = 17.5\) from \(B\) along \(AB.\)

Along the bisector from \(B,\) the component parallel to \(AB\) is \(BP\cos\dfrac{B}{2},\) which must reach the altitude’s foot: \(BP\cos\dfrac{B}{2} = 17.5.\)

Since \(\cos\dfrac{B}{2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{1 + \frac{7}{18}}{2}}\) \(= \sqrt{\dfrac{25}{36}}\) \(= \dfrac{5}{6},\) we get \(BP = \dfrac{17.5}{\frac{5}{6}} = 21.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
